raw_text: URGENT from Imphal — Telegram Meitei Community Group. The tribals have attacked our people in Churachandpur. Multiple villages along the Imphal-Churachandpur highway are burning. Armed mobs are targeting Meitei families in the hill districts. Our women and children are being evacuated from Kangpokpi. We need security forces NOW. The state police are outnumbered and the Army has not yet arrived. This is a coordinated assault on the Meitei community. Share this message — the mainstream media is not covering what is happening to us. Stay safe, stay together.
clean_text: Reports from Imphal indicate tribals have attacked Meitei communities in Churachandpur. Multiple villages along the Imphal-Churachandpur highway are burning. Armed mobs are reportedly targeting Meitei families in hill districts. Evacuations are underway from Kangpokpi. State police are outnumbered and the Army has not yet arrived. The community describes this as a coordinated assault.
